name: Grade 5 Mathematics: Multiplication of large numbers
subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to multiply a three-digit number by a two-digit number
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to solve word problems involving multiplication
learningActivities: Demonstration: teacher models 345 x 12 using place value
Guided practice: learners work through examples on the board
Independent work: learners solve multiplication sums and word problems
keyPoints: Multiply by the ones digit first, then the tens digit
Place a zero when multiplying by the tens digit
commonMisconceptions: Forgetting the zero placeholder when multiplying by tens
lessonEvaluation: Learners solve five multiplication sums and two word problems. Teacher marks and provides feedback.
teacherReflection: Most learners grasped the method. Remedial practice for the multiplication tables needed.
